paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: : Accuracy and reasoning chain length (# L) of on GSM8k dataset when trained with c{1,3,5,7} and tested with extra c{2,4,6} (under gray bars).
model_annotation: This line chart displays the accuracy (%) and the logarithm of reasoning chain length (#L) as functions of the compression factor (c), with the x-axis labeled “Compression Factor (c)” ranging linearly from 1 to 7 with integer tick marks, and two y-axes: the left axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” ranging linearly from 10 to 40 with intervals of 10, and the right axis labeled “log(#L)” ranging logarithmically from 1.5 to 3.0 with intervals of 0.5. The purple line, marked with circular data points and connected by solid lines, represents accuracy, starting at 40% at c=1, decreasing to 30% at c=2, rising to 34% at c=3, falling to 29% at c=4, remaining steady at 29% at c=5, dropping to 20% at c=6, and rising to 24% at c=7. The gold line, also marked with circular data points and connected by solid lines, represents log(#L), starting at 3.0 at c=1, decreasing to 2.5 at c=2, falling to 2.3 at c=3, continuing to decrease to 2.0 at c=4, to 1.9 at c=5, to 1.7 at c=6, and finally to 1.5 at c=7.
